[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Feature flags whose removal is a bead, a deadline, and a gate[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]SASE has one boolean feature-flag registry resolved through the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]existing config layer chain, every temporary flag is owned by a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]dedicated `flag` bead carrying a date-and-release removal [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]threshold, that threshold raises a FlagTriage gate the owner [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]answers with Remove / Extend / Keep / Close, flag beads read [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]unmistakably on every surface that renders a bead, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase/memory/sase_flags.md` teaches agents when a flag is warranted[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and how to retire one.[/#D7D7AF]
